text: {"findings":[{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Required ETA/promise guardrails absent","detail":"The proposal widens promise windows but lists only Cost Per Delivery as a guardrail. Delivery CSAT, Contact Rate and Promise Accuracy are all required for ETA and delivery promise changes.","evidence_quote":"- Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":["guardrail-standards#eta-and-delivery-promise-changes"],"recommendation":"Add Delivery CSAT, Contact Rate and Promise Accuracy as guardrails with numeric stop thresholds. Consider also tracking checkout conversion."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Randomization leaks, 1-week duration, no MDE or power","detail":"Randomizing by customer leaks effects between arms because customers share one supply pool. The 1-week run is under the 14-day minimum, and no MDE, power, sample size or stopping rule is recorded.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by customer. Run for 1 week. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference","experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality","experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Use a switchback, geo or market-level design and run at least 14 days, or get Data Science sign-off for a shorter test. Pre-register the primary metric, MDE, power and stopping rule."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"EXP-014 referenced but its learning ignored","detail":"The proposal says it follows EXP-014 but ignores that test's result and learning. EXP-014 found the on-time gain came from relaxed promises, with checkout conversion down 1.2%, and concluded that promise changes must be judged on Promise Accuracy and conversion, not OTD alone. The proposal still uses OTD as its only success metric.","evidence_quote":"Follows EXP-014, but only applies during storms rather than permanently.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Address the EXP-014 learning explicitly. Add Promise Accuracy and conversion to the evaluation, and explain why the storm-only scope avoids the conversion loss."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Weather impact and baseline cited without verifiable source","detail":"The problem statement attributes late deliveries to storms and cites only a generic 'LMD weather impact analysis'. The 78% baseline has no source at all.","evidence_quote":"baseline 78%, target 88% within 8 weeks","citations":[],"recommendation":"Link the specific analysis and data source for the 78% storm-time baseline and the storm-lateness claim."}]}
